titulo: Áudio: Projeto afasta hipóteses que relativizam crime de estupro de vulnerável
resumo: O projeto de lei que afasta hipóteses que relativizam o crime de estupro de vulnerável avançou em sua tramitação no Senado: o texto (PL 654/2026) foi aprovado pela Comissão de Direitos Humanos na quarta-feira (25) e agora segue para análise na Comissão de Constituição e Justiça. titulo: Áudio: Sistema desenvolvido no Senado auxilia legislativos a adotar práticas sustentáveis
resumo: A Comissão de Direitos Humanos e Legislação Participativa (CDH) debateu em audiência pública nesta quinta-feira (26) os desafios e avanços das assembleias legislativas e câmaras de vereadores nas áreas de acessibilidade, sustentabilidade e igualdade de gênero e raça, conforme as metas globais da ONU para 2030. Na audiência, o Senado apresentou o SIMPLS, plataforma gratuita que ajuda casas legislativas do país a planejar, acompanhar e divulgar com transparência suas ações socioambientais à sociedade. A presidente da comissão, senadora Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF), destacou a importância desses temas para a qualidade dos ambientes de trabalho.

titulo: Relatório do Orçamento de 2027 mantém aumento de recursos a saúde e educação
resumo: O relatório preliminar do Orçamento de 2027 prevê R$ 272,18 bilhões para a saúde pública e R$ 246,3 bilhões para a educação, além de recursos para manter o programa Bolsa Família. O texto, aprovado pela Comissão Mista de Orçamento (CMO), define as regras para a análise do projeto da Lei Orçamentária Anual (LOA) e os parâmetros de receita que vão orientar a distribuição das verbas federais. O texto é do senador Eduardo Braga (MDB-AM), relator-geral do Orçamento de 2027 (PLN 24/2026). Mantém para a saúde e a educação aumentos de recursos em relação a 2026. titulo: Áudio: Avançam mudanças na Taxa de Controle e Fiscalização Ambiental
resumo: Seguiu para análise da Comissão de Assuntos Econômicos (CAE) projeto que muda a cobrança da Taxa de Controle e Fiscalização Ambiental, permitindo que a empresa escolha entre duas formas de cálculo: com base na receita de cada estabelecimento, separadamente; ou no faturamento total da empresa, com pagamento de uma única taxa. Para o senador Confúcio Moura (MDB-RO), o projeto (PL 3.513/2024) atualiza a cobrança da taxa, adaptando-a aos conceitos de microempresa e empresa de pequeno porte.

titulo: Áudio: Especialistas sugerem ajustes nas regras de gestão das contas públicas
resumo: A Comissão de Transparência, Governança, Fiscalização e Controle (CTFC) do Senado fez nesta quinta-feira (26) uma audiência pública para discutir o projeto de lei que regulamenta o Conselho de Gestão Fiscal, previsto na Lei de Responsabilidade Fiscal desde 2000, mas ainda não instalado. Durante a reunião, o representante da Secretaria do Tesouro Nacional, Alex Fabiano Teixeira, reconheceu a importância do órgão, mas apontou a necessidade de ajustes no projeto (PL 3.520/2019) para garantir o funcionamento adequado do conselho.

titulo: Áudio: CDH aponta falhas no combate à violência contra crianças e adolescentes
resumo: A Comissão de Direitos Humanos do Senado (CDH) aprovou na quarta-feira (25) o relatório sobre o acompanhamento, feito pela comissão, do Plano Nacional de Enfrentamento da Violência contra Crianças e Adolescentes. O documento apontou falhas na implementação das ações previstas, como a falta de integração entre os serviços de saúde, assistência social e educação. Ouça o áudio.

titulo: Davi recebe prefeitos e propõe debate sobre financiamento dos municípios
resumo: O financiamento dos serviços públicos municipais, os impactos da mudança na jornada de trabalho e a distribuição de recursos entre União, estados e municípios estiveram entre os temas discutidos nesta quinta-feira (26) pelo presidente do Senado, Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP), e representantes da Frente Nacional de Prefeitas e Prefeitos (FNP). Durante o encontro, na Presidência do Senado, Davi propôs promover sessão especial para ampliar o debate sobre as demandas dos municípios. Em publicação nas redes sociais, o senador destacou a necessidade de construir soluções conjuntas para questões como saúde, segurança pública, equilíbrio das contas municipais e fortalecimento do pacto federativo. — Mai

titulo: Áudio: Penhora de imóvel de inquilino para ressarcir fiador vai a Plenário
resumo: A Comissão de Constituição e Justiça (CCJ) aprovou um projeto de lei que permite a penhora do único imóvel residencial de inquilino inadimplente para garantir o ressarcimento do fiador que pagou a dívida de aluguel. Hoje, ao tentar recuperar o valor pago na Justiça, o fiador muitas vezes esbarra na impenhorabilidade do imóvel pertencente ao próprio inquilino que pode possuir residência própria em outra cidade ou estado. O projeto (PL 3.595/2021) seguiu para o Plenário, com pedido de urgência.

resumo: O Poder Legislativo vem adotando medidas para garantir a acessibilidade, a equidade de gênero e raça, além de reduzir os impactos ambientais de suas atividades. Tais ações — que convergem com os Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável da ONU — foram apresentadas nesta quinta-feira (26) durante audiência pública no Senado. Uma das iniciativas apresentadas foi o sistema desenvolvido pelo Senado para apoiar os órgãos do Legislativo na adoção de práticas de governança, acessibilidade, equidade e sustentabilidade ambiental. titulo: Áudio: Audiência pública vai discutir inteligência artificial e novos riscos cibernéticos
resumo: A Comissão de Ciência, Tecnologia, Inovação e Informática (CCT) aprovou requerimento do senador Jorge Seif (PL-SC) para a promoção de audiência pública sobre o avanço dos agentes autônomos e dos modelos de inteligência artificial de fronteira (REQ 102/2026 - CCT). O debate também vai abordar a disputa tecnológica entre Estados Unidos e China e os impactos dessas tecnologias sobre a cibersegurança no Brasil e no mundo. A data do debate será definida pela comissão.

titulo: Áudio: Senado aprova bafômetro em acidentes e proíbe fiança em caso de morte
resumo: A Comissão de Constituição e Justiça (CCJ) aprovou projeto de lei que torna obrigatório o teste de alcoolemia ou exame clínico para motoristas envolvidos em acidentes de trânsito ou parados em uma blitz, e impede a concessão de fiança, graça, indulto ou anistia para quem matar ao volante sob efeito de álcool ou drogas (PL 1.229/2024). Se não houver recurso para votação em Plenário, a proposta segue para a análise da Câmara dos Deputados.

titulo: Mais tempo na escola não basta sem qualidade e verba, diz avaliação da CE
resumo: A expansão do ensino integral no Brasil é relevante e necessária, mas o êxito ainda depende de ajustes de qualidade e de financiamento adequado. A conclusão é da Comissão de Educação (CE), que aprovou nesta quarta-feira (25) o relatório de avaliação do Programa Escola em Tempo Integral, do Ministério da Educação. Criado em 2023, o programa apoia escolas de estados, municípios e do Distrito Federal na implantação da jornada integral, de pelo menos sete horas diárias. A avaliação foi proposta pela relatora, senadora Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF), por meio de requerimento. Damares definiu a avaliação de uma política pública como um trabalho complexo e informou que o relatório tem 393 páginas.

titulo: Spain's De Cos chosen as next ECB president
resumo: European leaders have agreed to nominate the former head of the Bank of Spain as the next president of the European Central Bank. Pablo ​Hernandez ‌de ⁠Cos will replace the outgoing Christine Lagarde as the bank faces pressure to tackle high inflation, borrowing costs, and government debt. Also in the show - US regulators give SpaceX the green light to send satellites for data centers into space, and American households face higher costs for their Thanksgiving celebrations.

titulo: Nigeria faces rising election violence in run up to vote
resumo: In tonight's edition, concerns are mounting that electoral violence could deter voters from taking part in Nigeria’s presidential election in January. Also, the driver of a car suspected of causing a fuel tanker to overturn on a major highway in Egypt is detained. And Sierra Leone was once considered the most dangerous place in the world to give birth. Today, maternal deaths have dropped dramatically.

titulo: Iranian monarchists disrupt Paris event, highlighting bitter diaspora divide
resumo: A Paris event on Iranian women's rights attended by French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot was disrupted when diaspora supporters of Reza Pahlavi, the US-based son of Iran's deposed shah, taunted left-leaning opponents of Iran's Islamic regime. The chaos underscored the bitter divides in the Iranian diaspora as the Iran war enters its tenth month.

titulo: Sanchez's big gamble: Will Spain swing from Socialists to hard right?
resumo: For eight years, he’s been a mainstay among European leaders, one who’s snatched victory from the jaws of defeat before but has Pedro Sanchez run out of road this time? Spain's Socialist prime minister dogged by incumbent fatigue and nepotism allegations. Sanchez gambled on turning the rift in his coalition over his country's housing shortage into a referendum on his country's strong growth and calling a snap general election.

titulo: Hamas weighs response after Israel kills 10 people in Gaza
resumo: Five Israeli strikes and a shooting overnight and on Thursday killed 10 Palestinians across Gaza, according to officials at Shifa and Al-Aqsa Martyrs hospitals, where the casualties were taken. A strike on a residential apartment in Deir Al-Balah in central Gaza killed a man and his wife, the officials said. FRANCE 24's Jennie Shin speaks with journalist Ahmed Dremly, who was in Gaza until six months ago and has extensively covered the humanitarian crisis there.

titulo: Trump urges Putin to end 'military aggression' in Europe
resumo: US President Donald Trump said Thursday he had asked Vladimir Putin to "pull back all military aggression" against Europe, in a shift in tone towards the leader Russian he called his friend just a week ago. Trump said he had made the request to Putin when they met in China last week, adding that he thought it would help lead to a deal to end Moscow's grinding war in Ukraine. The US leader's comments come a day after he hosted NATO chief Mark Rutte in Florida, after which they issued a joint statement calling on Russia not to expand the Ukraine war. FRANCE 24's international affairs editor Kethevane Gorjestani explains.

titulo: France's Bardella faces new allegations of anti-Semitic comments
resumo: French far-right leader Jordan Bardella on Thursday faced new accusations of having made anti-Semitic remarks as a teenager, after French media published extracts from previously unaired conversations online. The 31-year-old top ally of French presidential candidate Marine Le Pen has denied any wrongdoing after allegations emerged in September that he made conspiracist comments about Jewish people on Facebook in 2013. FRANCE 24's Solange Mougin reports.

titulo: Le Pen slams push for EU budget deal before French election
resumo: EU leaders locked horns over the bloc's budget at a summit meeting in Brussels on Thursday, as far-right leader Marine Le Pen slammed an "underhanded" push to lock in the long-term spending plans before French presidential elections next year. European Council head Antonio Costa turned up the pressure upon arrival at the budget talks, where heavyweight Germany is pressing for cuts as well as burden-sharing on money for Ukraine. FRANCE 24's Dave Keating reports from Brussels.

titulo: Marie-Antoinette’s porcelain ‘nipple bowl’ fetches record $3.1 million at Paris auction
resumo: A "jatte-teton", or nipple bowl, that once belonged to French Queen Marie-Antoinette fetched a record €2.9 million ($3.1 million) at Paris auction Thursday. The breast-shaped porcelain bowl was one of four such pieces which King Louis XVI once ordered for his queen's royal dairy creamery.

titulo: French far-right leader Jordan Bardella faces fresh allegations of anti-Semitism
resumo: The leader of France's far-right National Rally party, Jordan #Bardella, is facing fresh accusations of having made anti-Semitic remarks as a teenager. On Thursday, November 26, French media outlets Mediapart and Le Monde published new excerpts from private Facebook conversations dating back to 2013.

titulo: Reporters Without Borders demands suspension of controversial French TV channel CNews
resumo: Paris-based international press freedom group Reporters Without Borders (RSF) on Thursday called on France's media regulator Arcom to suspend right-wing channel CNews for one month over its failure to uphold pluralism. The news channel owned by conservative billionaire Vincent Bolloré condemned the call for its suspension.

titulo: Will Spain's far right replace Europe's left-wing stalwart?
resumo: Some 39 million Spaniards will head to the ballot this Sunday to vote in early general elections. Latest polls put the conservative Popular Party ahead of incumbent PM Pedro Sanchez’s Socialists. The third-strongest political force, however, is the far-right Vox party. A strong showing at Sunday’s election could see them form Spain’s next government. FRANCE 24 explains.

titulo: ACROSS AFRICA: Tunisian Photographer's Family Focus
resumo: Stories from the continent with Georja Calvin-Smith. This week, health workers struggling to keep pace with DR Congo's Ebola outbreak say they feel abandoned and unsupported. Also, the World Cup was about more than winning... for some fans, at least. Tunisia's performance may not have been all that its supporters had hoped, but sports photographer Hosni Manoubi is far from negative about a family tradition of documenting his country's international sports showings. [Archive Episode, June 2026]

titulo: In California, exceptional tides and nearly 9m-high waves batter the coast
resumo: USA: Powerful waves and king tides destroyed part of a pier in Pacifica, south of San Francisco, on Wednesday. In Marin County, authorities issued a temporary evacuation order and urged people to stay away from the beach.

titulo: Spanish economist de Cos to succeed Lagarde as head of ECB
resumo: Spanish monetary economist Pablo Hernandez de Cos on Thursday was set to replace France's Christine Lagarde as the new head of the European Central Bank (ECB). His nomination comes as the Europe's most powerful financial institution grapples with an Iran war-driven resurgence in inflation and a cost of living crisis.

titulo: Lost homes, stolen freedom: National Book Award winners on exile and imprisonment
resumo: Two books about losing everything have just won America's most prestigious literary honours. Hannah Lillith Assadi took the National Book Award for fiction for "Paradiso 17", a novel inspired by her late father, who was driven from Palestine in 1948 during the Nakba. Abdelrahman ElGendy won the non-fiction prize for "Huna", his memoir of six years as a political prisoner in Egypt, arrested at 17 alongside his father. ElGendy couldn't be in New York to collect his award: his visa was denied.

titulo: How far-right Vox is winning over young voters ahead of Spain's snap election
resumo: Spain's Vox party is winning over many young people ahead of the country's snap election on November 29, particularly men. The far-right party is capitalising on the rising cost of living and anti-immigrant sentiment to expand its once-marginal electoral base.

titulo: Across Africa: The Scars of South Africa's Soweto Uprising
resumo: 50 years ago, thousands of young South Africans from Soweto protested against apartheid's stranglehold on their education and the imposition of Afrikaans as a language of instruction. What began as a peaceful protest ended in bloodshed. And men in Northern Benin confront uncomfortable realities about the lives of the women who live and love them. [Archive edition, June 2026]

titulo: From leadership crises to tech outages, can corporations rebuild public trust?
resumo: From cyberattacks to network failures to leadership crises, tech corporations are showing signs of vulnerability. The dramatic resignation and return of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has underscored the potential risk of depending on a single leader, both for the company and the entire AI industry. Meanwhile, global outages at Microsoft and a number of US banks have showcased declining public trust in institutions.

titulo: Mad about mara: the DIY dance movement helping young Nigerians escape the daily grind
resumo: What started as one artist’s response to being cut out of a music video has exploded, becoming a driving force in Nigeria’s cultural landscape As a student in the central Nigerian city of Ilorin, Lawal Habeeb Kola loved staying in his hostel room to produce beats rather than returning to his family house in Lagos, the more frenetic city of his birth. In 2022, one of his beats became popular on TikTok, and a version featuring ad-libbed vocals from a hypeman sent it viral. He was invited to the music video shoot in Lagos and thought his big break had finally come, but when the video was released, he was absent. Continue reading...

titulo: ‘I’m no longer a UAE official’: UN hopeful Lana Nusseibeh tries to shake off Sudan record
resumo: The US and Russia’s candidate for secretary general is on a charm offensive. Can she overcome London’s resistance to her bid? Lana Nusseibeh is in Britain this week, attempting to present herself as a potential future UN secretary general, and shift the focus from her past as a United Arab Emirates diplomat who denied the country’s role in arming a militia accused of war crimes and genocide in Sudan’s four-year civil war. It is a high-risk strategy that involves meeting ministers, MPs, academics and holding a public event with the UN Association. Continue reading...

titulo: New Zealand election: final results show ruling coalition needs minor party to govern
resumo: Incumbent prime minister Christopher Luxon loses majority and needs support of Opportunity party to remain in power, or country faces another election The final results of New Zealand’s general election show the incumbent rightwing coalition will need the support of a centrist newcomer party to form a government, and to avoid sending the country back to the polls. Preliminary results on 7 November handed the National party and its two coalition partners, the populist New Zealand First and libertarian Act parties, a slim two-seat majority, making the election too close to call until final votes were tallied. Continue reading...

titulo: Threat from China looms large over Taiwan’s local elections
resumo: Taiwanese officials raise alarm over interference by China in elections that will shape fortunes of ruling party Taiwanese voters go to the polls on Saturday in closely watched local elections that will shape the fortunes of the ruling Democratic Progressive party (DPP) as it navigates an increasingly precarious set of relationships on the global stage. Saturday’s vote will choose mayors, council members and other local leaders across 22 districts. Unlike the presidential elections, in which foreign policy is often a key issue, the local elections, held every four years , are largely focused on bread-and-butter issues such as housing affordability and wealth distribution. Continue reading...

titulo: China reserves right to take ‘necessary measures’ after Trump’s new tariff proposals
resumo: Beijing says new levies amount to ‘political manipulation’, while Brazil ‘will not yield to this type of threat’ Trump proposing new tariffs on 14 partners including China and EU Beijing has said it reserves the right to take “necessary measures” after Donald Trump’s administration proposed new tariffs on goods from China and other major trading partners, triggering a global backlash. Among the suggested levies on 14 major trading partners announced on Wednesday, China is potentially facing one of the biggest hits. It would face the highest capped rate of 20%, which in some cases will be stacked on top of other import taxes for a total rate of 45%. Continue reading...

titulo: ‘Trapped in grief’: wife of Japanese journalist detained by Russia pleads for his release
resumo: Yuki Imai being held in Moscow on allegations he conducted ‘espionage’ while working for a newspaper in Sakhalin island in Russia’s far east The wife of a Japanese journalist who has been detained in Russia for more than a month on suspicion of spying has issued an emotive appeal for his release. Yuki Imai, a reporter for the Hokkaido Shimbun, was arrested in mid-October as he was preparing to return to Japan from a two-year assignment at the Japanese newspaper’s bureau in the city of Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, on the island of Sakhalin in Russia’s far east. Continue reading...

titulo: Erin Patterson launches high court appeal bid over mushroom murder convictions
resumo: Patterson, 52, seeks leave to appeal to Australia’s highest court over deaths of estranged family members after fatal beef wellington lunch Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Erin Patterson has applied to the high court seeking leave to appeal after a failed bid last month to overturn her triple murder conviction. Patterson, 52, was found guilty last year of the murders of her estranged husband’s parents, Don and Gail Patterson, and his aunt Heather Wilkinson, after she hosted them for lunch. Continue reading...

titulo: Alan Jones defence opens and closes in space of a few hours as indecent assault trial draws to a close
resumo: Former broadcaster, 85, has pleaded not guilty to 21 counts of sexual touching and indecent assault Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Alan Jones’s defence in his indecent assault and sexual touching trial has lasted only a few hours, with closing submissions in the long-running case due next week. Jones’s barrister Gabrielle Bashir SC opened the defence case on Friday by stating, “I am not calling the defendant,” ending months of speculation about whether the former broadcaster, 85, would give evidence. Continue reading...

titulo: Former RAAF pilot convicted of murder after staging wife’s death as lawnmower accident
resumo: Brisbane supreme court jury finds Robert John Crawford guilty of murder after he stood to lose financially in divorce settlement Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Former air force pilot Robert John Crawford has been found guilty of the murder of his wife after a jury accepted her death was staged as a fatal lawnmower accident. Gasps and sobs could be heard in Brisbane supreme court on Friday after the jury returned a guilty verdict after deliberating since 10am on Tuesday. Continue reading...

titulo: Heatwaves, floods, fires and rain: weekend of weather extremes expected across Australia
resumo: As bushfires ravage Flinders Island, Victorians can expect a wet and windy election day as storms forecast on east coast Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Major fires are among a multitude of weather extremes forecast across Australia on Friday and into the weekend, which also includes severe storms, heavy rain, floods and heatwaves. Firefighters contending with an out-of-control bushfire on Flinders Island expected conditions to deteriorate further on Friday, as authorities confirmed at least eight buildings had been destroyed or significantly damaged. Continue reading...

titulo: Qantas and Air New Zealand planes too close at Sydney airport as ‘mental models’ of crews to be investigated
resumo: Aborted descent on Wednesday morning is latest in a series of landing incidents at Sydney airport Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The Australian Transport Safety Bureau is investigating flight crews’ “mental models” after a Qantas plane aborted its landing at Sydney airport on Wednesday after noticing another aircraft crossing the runway while on its descent. The ATSB said Qantas flight 426 from Melbourne was due to land just before 10.15am on Wednesday, with the Boeing 737 jet told to expect a late landing clearance due to aircraft crossing the runway. Continue reading...

titulo: Race hate exploded in this Spanish town last year. Now its residents are bracing for more
resumo: Torre-Pacheco’s diverse communities are fearful that the far-right Vox party will enter government after Sunday’s election Sitting on a park bench, taking in the sunny day, Naima reflected on all that had seemingly changed since she moved to Spain three decades earlier. Back then, the Moroccan national had felt warmly welcomed by Spaniards. “I had never, at any point in my life, felt like there was racism,” she said. “But now things are changing. And the blame lies with rightwing politics.” Continue reading...

titulo: How much of the sharp fall in UK immigration is due to Labour’s policies?
resumo: Labour is jubilant it has got numbers down to levels the Tories could not but it was helped by factors beyond its control Net migration to UK falls to lowest level since 1997 excluding pandemic David Cameron was the leader of the opposition when he made a comment on overall migration that was used to interrogate every Tory leader for the next 14 years. Asked in January 2010 on the BBC by the interviewer Andrew Marr to address comments made by the archbishop of Canterbury calling for the population to remain under 70 million, Cameron said net immigration levels of 200,000 a year were “too much”. Continue reading...

titulo: What would happen if Russia detonated a nuclear weapon in space?
resumo: ⁠Sputnik-S, a nuclear-enabled satellite, has been assembled by Russia and could be launched in 60 days, reports say Russia is reportedly preparing to launch a nuclear-armed satellite into space later this year, in a scenario that could pose a significant threat to global communications. German media outlets have reported, citing western intelligence agency assessments, that such a satellite could be launched within 60 days and would be operational shortly afterwards. Continue reading...

titulo: EU leaders wrestle over Ukraine aid as potential Le Pen victory sparks fear
resumo: Slovakia, Hungary and Czechia want to opt out of €45bn Ukraine loan, as Germany tries to protect funding from possible far-right French presidency Europe live – latest updates EU leaders were bracing for a clash over long-term financial aid for Ukraine amid an effort to finalise high-stakes budget talks by the end of the year. Arriving in Brussels on Thursday, the German chancellor, Friedrich Merz, reiterated his view that all EU member states should support a €45bn (£38bn) loan for Ukraine for 2027. “When the European Union provides funding, it does so as the European Union – and that union consists of 27 member states, not 23 or 24,” he said. Continue reading...

titulo: Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos wins race to be next ECB president
resumo: Former Bank of Spain governor chosen to succeed Christine Lagarde after winning support of EU’s biggest countries Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos has been chosen as the next president of the European Central Bank, to succeed Christine Lagarde, after winning support from the EU’s biggest countries. The economist and monetary policymaker will become the first Spaniard to lead the ECB, defeating his rival candidate Klaas Knot, the former head of the Dutch central bank. Continue reading...

resumo: Depois de o primeiro-ministro ter batido com a porta, em entrevista à RTP, à implementação de medidas como o IVA Zero e a alteração do IRS sobre as rendas, no quadro do Orçamento do Estado, sucederam-se as reações das forças da oposição. resumo: Gonçalo Matias recusa qualquer "confronto institucional" e afirma que se houver uma crise política, "seguramente não será o Governo a causá-la".

resumo: Dois médicos foram apanhados a usar óculos com Inteligência Artificial na Prova Nacional de Acesso à formação especializada.

resumo: A agência espacial europeia revelou as primeiras imagens do asteroide Dimorphos depois de ter sido atingido por uma nave da NASA.

titulo: Filipe Coelho vê Universitatea Craiova ser goleada na visita ao Brighton
resumo: Os romenos do Universitatea Craiova perderam hoje em Inglaterra com o Brighton, por 4-0, na primeira derrota averbada pela formação treinada pelo português Filipe Coelho na Liga Conferência Europa de futebol, após quatro jornadas.

titulo: Espanha confirma favoritismo e está nas meias-finais da Taça Davis em ténis
resumo: A Espanha cumpriu hoje o que dela se esperava e venceu a Áustria por 2-0, para completar o conjunto de seleções apuradas para as meias-finais da Taça Davis de ténis, que decorre em Bolonha.

titulo: In a fertility advance, engineered molecular glue stabilizes chromosomes in aging eggs
resumo: Researchers engineered a protein system capable of restoring normal chromosome connections in aging mouse eggs, raising hopes of one day improving IVF outcomes

titulo: STAT+: The grueling struggle to find a primary care doctor in the ‘medical capital’ of America
resumo: Boston is supposed to be the medical capital of America. Yet many don’t have primary care access, hurting their ability to get treatments, screenings, and medical advice.

titulo: Strobe Talbott, former Time magazine reporter and deputy secretary of state, has died
resumo: Strobe Talbott, a former Time magazine reporter who later served as deputy secretary of state under President Bill Clinton and then headed the Brookings Institution, died Thursday. He was 80.

resumo: As the fast-moving outbreak continues to spread in eastern Congo, fighting between rebels and the army is disrupting efforts to contain the spread of the disease.

resumo: Leader Kim Jong Un reportedly visited facilities that produce nuclear ingredients and called for building more nuclear weapons to cope with threats from the U.S. and South Korea.

resumo: The East Coast's weather is a major concern this holiday, as it could lead to coastal flooding. And, the judge says the FCC can't punish ABC for satire Trump doesn't like.

titulo: At Albuquerque's Indian Pueblo Kitchen, Native American dishes are the main course
resumo: At an Albuquerque, N.M., museum, the restaurant is just as much of a draw as the exhibitions, with dishes like green chile stew and sweet biscochitos flavored with anise and cinnamon.

resumo: New Orleans Chef Alon Shaya's new cookbook shares stories of resilience from World War II, centered around food.

resumo: NPR's Leila Fadel welcomes culinary historian Michael Twitty into her kitchen for a Thanksgiving cooking session on making Kush, the forerunner to Southern cornbread dressing.

resumo: LUMA Energy took over the electric grid five years ago. The court's ruling nullifies its contract, and gives the government a year to find a new operator.

resumo: Extreme weather that has unleashed strong winds, high tides, heavy rain and floods is expected to impact travel plans of an estimated 81.5 million people as they travel across the United States.

titulo: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
resumo: The Trump administration gave Elon Musk's SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a move that has raised skepticism among scientists.

titulo: Stormy Thanksgiving weather causes delays and damages for many Americans
resumo: A stormy Thanksgiving day led to serious flooding, major power outages and disrupted travel plans. By Thursday evening, more than 900,000 customers were without power in at least eight states. The East Coast is grappling with a pair of storm systems affecting people from Maine to Florida. This as strong winds battered the West Coast from Oregon to California. Lisa Desjardins reports.

titulo: News Wrap: EPA reports 'zero' airborne lead in Iowa
resumo: In our news wrap Thursday, the EPA is reporting "zero" airborne lead in Middletown, Iowa, a day after the Army detonated nearly five tons of toxic explosives, the Trump administration is planning for new, sharp tariffs on 14 countries, and President Trump says he told Russian president Vladimir Putin to "pull back on military aggression" in Europe.

titulo: Despite political divide, Americans often 'speak in one voice'
resumo: In this era of sharp American divide, politics has increasingly become a dish families work to keep off the Thanksgiving table. But in reality, data show Americans actually agree on many tough topics, spanning more than 100 policies. Lisa Desjardins spoke with two leading researchers whose counter-intuitive findings suggest our division is based on politics, not policy.

titulo: How Democrats' election successes could lead to new climate change policies
resumo: Even though it did not play a major role on the campaign trail, with Democrats' commanding wins nationwide as well as at the state level, some environmental groups are convinced that more substantive action is just around the corner. Caroline Spears, executive director of the advocacy group the Climate Cabinet, joins Williams Brangham to discuss.

titulo: How women in Israel are playing larger roles in the military
resumo: Israel has now been at war for the last three years, often alongside the United States. While women have long been at the forefront of the Israel Defense Forces, their roles are now expanding. Special correspondent Nurit Ben looks at their unique challenges.

titulo: Journalist's experiences highlight challenges of being a family caregiver
resumo: More than 60 million Americans are caregivers for their family members, providing a wide range of needs. In November that work is recognized as National Family Caregivers Month. Richard Lui, a caregiver advocate who has directed two documentaries on the subject, joins Amna Nawaz to discuss.
